info.title: Address APIs
info.description: Look up real-world postal addresses through Reltio's address provider integration. Provides text-based candidate search and single-address fetch by provider id — typically called in tandem (search returns ids, fetch resolves a chosen id to its full details).

environment.description: Reltio environment name (e.g. dev, qa, prod)

get.description: Searches for possible addresses matching the given text and returns a list of candidate addresses with their provider ids. Use the returned id with GET /address/fetch to get full details for a chosen candidate. Container can be used to drill into the children of a previous candidate (e.g. expanding a country into its regions); Countries scopes the search to specific ISO country codes; Language controls the language of returned address parts.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: Search text to match against candidate addresses.

parameters.name: Container
parameters.description: Continuation token from a previous candidate to drill into its children.

parameters.name: Countries
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes scoping the search.

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description: Language code controlling the language of returned address parts.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of candidate addresses to return.

get.description: Retrieves the full details for a single candidate address by its provider-specific id. The id is typically a value previously returned by GET /address/search.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Provider-specific identifier of the address to fetch.

AddressCandidate.description: A candidate postal address returned by the address provider.

id.description: Provider-specific identifier of the candidate address. Pass to GET /address/fetch to resolve to full details.

text.description: Primary display text for the candidate (e.g. the matched street line).

description.description: Secondary display text for the candidate (e.g. city, region, country).

type.description: Provider-specific candidate type (e.g. Address, Container, Postcode).

countryCode.description: ISO country code of the candidate.
